task_completion.description: Incorporate at least four new partition walls and five interior doors into the existing shell.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for newly drawn wall segments (usually darker or highlighted during creation) and door icons placed within those walls in the 2D plan or 3D view.

task_completion.description: Define and name at least five functional zones: Reception, Relaxation Lounge, Treatment Rooms, and Locker/Wet Rooms.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for text labels or room tags in the 2D floor plan identifying these specific names.

task_completion.description: Apply distinct floor colors or textures to at least three rooms to separate wet and dry areas.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Observe the 3D view or 2D plan for different colored or textured floor polygons in at least three distinct rooms.

task_completion.description: Furnish Treatment Rooms with at least three beds (massage tables), three storage units, and three therapist seats.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least 3 bed models, 3 cabinets/wardrobes/chests, and 3 chairs/stools within the designated treatment areas.

task_completion.description: Furnish Locker/Wet Rooms with at least four wardrobes (lockers), two showers, and two toilets or sinks.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least 4 tall cabinet/wardrobe models, 2 shower stall icons/models, and 2 plumbing fixtures (sinks/toilets) in the wet areas.

task_completion.description: Furnish Reception/Lounge with at least one desk, three lounge seats, and two decorative plants.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify 1 desk/table, 3 armchairs/sofas, and 2 plant models in the entry or lounge zones.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place objects and draw walls.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, the 2D plan, and the 'Create Walls' or 'Create Rooms' tools.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply open a pre-made complete file but actively modified the starter file.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the progression of walls being drawn and furniture being dragged from the catalog into the plan.

integrity.description: The agent saved the file to the specific requested path.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Save As' dialog box or the window title bar should reflect the path /home/ga/Documents/spa_layout.sh3d.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with a shell file named 'spa_wellness_starter.sh3d' which is a stripped version of SweetHome3DExample7.sh3d. The agent must use the built-in catalog only. Success requires 5 named zones, 4 new walls, 5 doors, 3 rooms with custom floor textures, and specific furniture counts: 3 beds/3 storage/3 seats (Treatment), 4 wardrobes/2 showers/2 sinks or toilets (Wet), and 1 desk/3 lounge seats/2 plants (Reception).
